name: Elympia Dark (lager)
description: One of the most popular drinks in Evangless, this satyr-brewed dark lager never fails to pick one’s spirits up. It’s rich flavor re- stores 4 hit points per glass. A bottle contains 10 glasses worth. It costs 1 AP per glass to drink. Please drink responsibly.

name: CRIMSON (clothing line)
description: by Crimson Marshal Lucinda Mirasol This controversial fashion line by the infamous Evanglessian militarist didn’t get its name simply for its creator’s rank; each piece cannot be caught on tier 1 fire! This clothing counts as minimal armor and is guaranteed to look downright dashing in every season.

name: Mindcuffs
description: Developed by the Dolby Home for the Scientifically Unstable, these handcuffs can be used for one action point grabs. Attach- able to a maximum of two body parts, any hands or legs grabbed become unusable. Perfect for keeping any doomsday-machine obsessed evil genius unable to build, the target can only free a body part by making a tier 2 brute resist or by the cuffs’ owner releasing them.

name: Water Filter
description: An essential gadget for safari hunters and desert scavengers alike, this handy tool attaches to any flask or bottle. Simply by tipping it over you will pour out any impurities leaving only the cleanest of water behind. It can be used 15 times before breaking and is concealable.

name: Any-Altitude Parachute
description: This state-of-the-art parachute by Spendo deploys quickly for one reflexive action point whenever you’re falling. Never take falling damage again! While not concealable, its multi-stage deployment process ensures it will protect whether you fall 5 feet or 500 feet! SPENDO-BRAND: 91.6% GUARANTEED!

name: Spendo-Grenade
description: Sometimes you just have to blow something up. Spendo under- stands. That’s why he created the Spendo-Grenade. This conceal- able bomb is a statuette of Spendo the gnome himself (if Spendo smelled like gunpowder, had dark green skin and clothes, and made ticking sounds like a bomb). It costs 1 action point to ac- tivate the bomb and 2 action points to throw it. It will explode at the beginning of your next turn. It deals 10 damage to everyone in your target square and all squares adjacent to it. People in those squares can spend 1 action point to attempt a resist the impending explosion with their Dexterity. If they recieve a tier 2 result or higher, they take no damage and move out of the blast range. SPENDO-BRAND: 91.6% GUARANTEED!

name: Spendo-Brand Illumitorch
description: Whether you’re afraid of the dark or simply can’t see in it, Spen- do the gnome has the perfect fix! Torches are hot and can burn you; that’s dangerous! Use Spendo’s illumitorches instead! Eas- ily wielded in one hand and concealable, Spendo illumitorches consist of small hand-cranked bulbs which project light 25 feet around themselves. SPENDO-BRAND: 91.6% GUARANTEED!

name: The Lawn-Deformer (chainsaw)
description: Spendo brings you his newest product in his line of landscaping tools. Designed with vigilante gardeners in mind, this nifty chain- saw acts as a medium weapon. Whenever you successfully hit an opponent, you can spend an action point to deal 1 unsoakable damage to them by spinning the chainsaw blades. This can be done as many times as you have remaining action points during your current turn. SPENDO-BRAND: 91.6% GUARANTEED!

name: Gas-Fabulous (gasmask)
description: Based on a design by the Coaldust Unions of Evangless, this handy gasmask gives its wearer a +4 to resists against alchemical gases. But you shouldn’t buy from them, oh no! Buy your gas- mask from Spendo and his hard-working artisans will customize the mask’s appearance for free! SPENDO-BRAND: 91.6% GUARANTEED!

name: Protective Goggles
description: Spendo doesn’t like dirt in his eyes. Neither should you! These handy industrial goggles protect you from dirt and other things too! They grant you +1 to your soak class against called shots to your eyes and a +3 to Brute resists against anything that would affect your eyes. SPENDO-BRAND: 91.6% GUARANTEED!

name: Grapple Gun
description: Perfect for the gentleman thief on the run, this grapple-gun can propel up to 50 feet of chain, rope, or cable and will attach to rocky, magnetic, rough, or slick surfaces. It will increase your climb speed by 20 feet while you retract the cord towards its latch. It costs 1 action point to shoot your grapple-gun, 1 action point to unlatch it, and 1 action point to retract it to climb. Just be wary, this trinket isn’t concealable. Maskedmen Inc. Unleash Your Inner Rogue!

name: Chains of Security
description: Back by popular demand, Red-Gate Security is proud to present the Chains of Security! Attachable to any item, a single chain can secure an item to its owner’s hands, granting the wielder a +2 on resists against the item being disarmed. red-gate: Keeping Evangless Safe

name: Tinted Glasses
description: Standard-issue for the Evanglessian military police, these styl- ish pieces of eyewear art by Red-Gate Security protect your eyes from the harmful rays of the sun, as well as any flashes of light. Wearing them grants you a +3 to resist being blinded by flashes of light. red-gate: Keeping Evangless Safe

name: Heat-Sight Monocle
description: You’re in the middle of a barfight. Your chosen foe pushes a table on its side and ducks behind it. Your curiousity piques. What is he doing back there? With a Heat-Sight monocle from Masked- Men Incorporated, you could see his heat signature clear as day! This handy monocle allows you to see heat through anything deemed poor cover. Maskedmen Inc. Unleash Your Inner Rogue!

name: Hidden Intentions (poison)
description: At Maskedmen Incorporated, we believe subtlety is the greatest weapon in any gentleman’s arsenal. Simply add a dose of Hid- den Intentions to your target’s food or drink. Requiring a Tier 3 Cunning resist to detect the added ingredient in their meal, your target will take 6 unsoakable damage roughly 6 seconds or three action points after they ingest it. Maskedmen Inc. Unleash Your Inner Rogue!

name: Reasonable Doubt (auto lockpick)
description: The premier product of Maskedmen Incorporated, this automat- ed lockpicking device keeps the lock fingerprint-free. It spends 1 action point lockpicking any lock it’s attached to whenever your action points refresh. One-handed and concealable, you can place it on a lock for 1 action point or throw it at a lock for 2 action points. Maskedmen Inc. Unleash Your Inner Rogue! *Though there are some rumors concerning the legitimacy and morality of Maskedmen Incorporated, all of their agents have been very forthright with us and leave us no reason to question the validity of their company.

name: Graviton Board
description: A small hoverboard perfect for anyone wanting to travel in style, this premium clanker by Burgenhind Industries may not fly through the air, but it quickly skims across land and the surface of water! With a speed of 40 feet per action point and 12 wounds (losing 5 feet of speed whenever it takes damage), you’ll be the envy of all pedestrians in your path! Burgenhind Industries: Need a Lift?

name: The Fashionable Arrival (flight pack)
description: The latest in personal transportation clankers by Burgenhind Industries, this graviton-sphere powered pack features a stylish brass finish and fits comfortably on the back of any tailcoat or corset. For every action point you spend moving it, the Fashion- able Arrival will fly up to 40 feet. It has 12 wounds and loses 5 feet of movement whenever damaged. If you aren’t arriving fashion- ably, why show up at all? Burgenhind Industries: Need a Lift?

name: Horse
description: AP: 3; HP: 16; Wounds: 9; Pri: +0; Speed: 50 ft (×2 if all AP spent moving); Eva: −1; Def: +1; Soak (T1–T4): 3/6/9/12 (hide); Attack: Hoof 2 AP, natural medium, Acc +0, Stk +1, dmg 6/12/18/24

name: Canine
description: AP: 3; HP: 12; Wounds: 8; Pri: +0; Speed: 40 ft; Eva: +0; Def: +0; Soak (T1–T4): 2/4/6/8 (hide); Attack: Bite 2 AP, natural medium, Acc +1, Stk +3, dmg 6/12/18/24; +1 Stk per ally within 25 ft with Pack Instincts; can move–attack–move

name: Bird of prey
description: AP: 3; HP: 11; Wounds: 8; Pri: +0; Speed: 25 ft, 45 ft flight; Eva: +1; Def: +0; Soak (T1–T4): 0 (unarmored); Attack: Talon 2 AP, natural light, Acc +3, Stk +1, dmg 4/8/12/16; after 10+ ft dive target Brute resist vs Agility (+2) or prone

name: Aether Resonator
description: Gathers aether; worn as a backpack (2 hands to carry otherwise). Light sources near it shine 5× as far; the carrier ignores the ill effects of cold weather. Sync/desync with a weapon or glove: 3 AP. 3 augment slots (beta 5).

name: Manipulator Glove
description: Shape aether into a melee or thrown weapon for 1 AP without taking damage (without it: 10 HP damage, only basic soak). While worn, your unarmed attacks use your aether. A prosthetic hand counts as a glove.

name: Aether-Shaped Weapon
description: Shaped from aether (1 AP; pick the size). Up to 3 augments (5 with Beta Weapons), 1 AP per slot: Accurate, Aerodynamic, Bone-Shattering, Damaging, Deflecting, Horrifying, Inspiring, Luminous (×5), Powerful, Propelled, Reach, Returning, Signature Weapon (no Custom needed), Streamlined, Tangling – any known weapon augment with Aetherform Modules. Dissipates when released; can't be sundered unless its resonator is.

name: State-of-the-Art Resonator
description: Light, concealable, self-lit resonator. 780 pr to buy, 156 pr to craft; not maintained through DIY.

name: Self-Lit Resonator (medium)
description: Medium-sized self-lit resonator. 60 pr to buy, 12 pr to craft.

name: Turret (basic)
description: Turret kit: assemble 3 AP (Master Assembler −1). Must be in Footing stance to fire (Fast Mounting: not needed). Turret: 15 wounds, soak 1, gives its user light cover (also when broken). Can't fire on its own (Automated augment).

name: Crafted munitions (bulk)
description: Crafted firearm/crossbow/bow ammo type, 1 augment slot. Switching type 1 AP (bows free).

name: Beta munition (single round)
description: Single crafted round/arrow/bolt, 3 augment slots; gone once fired. Others need Sciences one tier above its highest marque.

name: Base Explosive Material
description: Volatile. Ignites for 5 damage to everything within 5 ft; doesn't enlarge or stack with other blasts (the higher damage applies). If carried and you roll a natural 1 on any physical activity, it explodes. Explodes on contact with fire; fails when damp.

name: Common Explosive Material
description: Only set off by another explosion or a blasting cap. 5 damage within 5 ft, same non-stacking rule. Explodes on contact with fire; fails when damp.

name: Water-Proofing
description: Explosive materials don't fail when damp (still won't go off when submerged).

name: Blasting Cap
description: Tiny detonator, lit by a fuse. 1 damage to someone next to it; sets off adjacent explosive material.

name: Basic Squib
description: 5 damage when detonated; short built-in fuse (seconds).

name: Gunpowder Line (50 ft)
description: Price ½ d. Burns 5 ft per turn; broken by tier 3 wind, water or a brushing foot.

name: Basic Fuse (50 ft)
description: Burns 10 ft per turn; put out by water, cutting or snuffing (1 AP); won't burn underwater.

name: Underwater Fuse (50 ft)
description: Burns 10 ft per turn, insulated; only stopped by cutting. +3 d per 50 ft for 20 ft per turn.

name: Fast Fuse (50 ft)
description: Burns 20 ft per turn; put out by water, cutting or snuffing (1 AP); not underwater.

name: Detonator Cord (50 ft)
description: Burns 25 miles per turn (effectively instant); not underwater.

name: Electrical Fuze (50 ft)
description: Instant over any distance; works underwater.

name: Flint & Steel
description: Price ¼ d. 3 AP to light something.

name: Matches (pack of 10)
description: 2 AP to light a fuse; a single match costs ⅛ d.

name: Lighter
description: 1 AP to light a fuse; steady small flame.

name: Trench Lighter
description: 1 AP; stays lit in everything below tier 4 rain or wind.

name: Flameless Lighter
description: 1 AP; lights fuses without an open flame.

name: Explosive (crafted)
description: Light, thrown. Activate 1 AP, throw 2 AP; explodes at the start of your next turn. 10 damage per marque (mQ I–IV 10/20/30/40) in the target space and all adjacent spaces; Dexterity resist (1 AP reflexive). Market price mQ I–IV 5/25/125/625 pr.

name: Firebomb (crafted)
description: Light, thrown; lands in the target space even on a miss. Activate 1 AP, throw 2 AP. 3 damage per marque (3/6/9/12) to the target space and all adjacent spaces; burns until the end of the activator's next turn and hurts anyone who enters or ends their turn there. Market price mQ I–IV 3/15/75/375 pr.

name: Squib (crafted)
description: Light, thrown; detonates within seconds. Activate 1 AP, throw 2 AP. 5 damage per marque (5/10/15/20) to the target only; normal Evade, soakable. Marque from Alchemy. Market price mQ I–IV 1/5/25/125 pr.

name: Living liquid (vial)
description: Airtight vial with a living liquid. Release 2 AP (smash: 1 AP, improper). Add its augments in the object creator.

name: Lord Hazard's Signet
description: Golden signet ring of the Hazard rulers, bound to each new Lord at the coronation.

name: Gambler's Graven Gift
description: Skull-engraved bone die from Rilausia's gambling houses; brings fortune and ruin.

name: The Evanglessian 51st Cavalier Division's Emblem
description: Cheap steel emblem of the 51st (ironbird pilots); glory in battle and a safe return.

name: Pike's Feather
description: Feather in bank robber Danny Pike's hat; it never gets damaged.

name: The Poor Man's Mark
description: Black ink tattooed as an eye on a victim; it reappears if removed.

name: The Stray Cat's Eye
description: Green tiger's-eye gem in an old Haudi brooch; it ruins thieves (bound to whoever steals it).

name: Ruinous Rifle
description: Antique Evanglessian military rifle, cursed by a gnome priest in the Loveless Wars.

name: Albrecht's Pipe
description: Pipe given to the Aldamiir fop Albrecht by a feuding family.
